list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them; guides in this file's own words

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are earned; it has no task of its own. Follow the roadmap in this guide: clear the missable trophies before the finale, then sweep collectibles and grind trophies in cleanup and the Platinum pops with the last one.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the first story mission, so it cannot be missed; the trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock on their own as the story advances; nothing extra is needed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks automatically when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops at the chapter's end; keep the story moving and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale; it unlocks when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the final mission to its end. Do the missable trophies first — once the story is over, some one-time moments are gone — then finish the story and this gold trophy pops with it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Story missions can be replayed, so this one cannot be missed; play it through and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a set-piece heist mission in the story; finish it and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies it unlocks on completion and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the mission through; the trophy unlocks when it ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown mission. Finish it and the trophy pops; story missions are replayable, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's checklist: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the counted challenges all feed into it. This is a late-game gold — clear the story and the missables first, then use the in-game completion stats to mop up whatever is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, long air time and other stunt moments all count toward the total. The count builds up naturally while driving hard; in cleanup, chain jumps off ramps and highway crests to finish the last of them.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the WAiNK photo spots all count as their own type. Visit one of each and the trophy pops; the activity icons on the map show where each type lives.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores accuracy and speed, so slow down for headshots rather than spraying: a clean run beats a fast sloppy one. Work through the ranges one weapon at a time and replay any challenge that lands silver until it turns gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are about clean lines through the gates, not top speed: cut corners tight, avoid full-throttle overshoots, and learn each course's gate order before pushing for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race event counts once. Spread across the map's race types (street, off-road, boat and air races all count as races) and keep a mental list of the ones already won so no win is wasted on a repeat.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take Cal's challenges when he offers them at the fishing spots, and fish with the right bait for the spot's fish: match the bait to the water and reel steadily instead of yanking, and Cal's score is beatable on a clean catch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Pick the shortest cabinet game, learn its one mechanic, and play it through to the end screen — finishing is what counts, not the score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand to its final mission. Character strands unlock as the story advances; keep taking Andy's missions whenever his icon appears and the strand ends with its final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand to its final mission. Take his missions as they appear through the story and the strand closes with its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand to its final mission. Work through his missions in order as they unlock and the final one closes the strand.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as question-mark icons on the map — take them as they appear instead of leaving them for after the story, because some strangers are only around during certain story stretches. Eight finished strands, not eight single missions, is what the trophy counts.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand to its final mission. Take his missions as they unlock through the story and the strand ends with its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission. Work his missions in order as they appear and the final mission closes the strand.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are scenic overlooks and quiet corners marked on the map once found; sit, meditate, and move to the next. A clean sweep in one road trip is the fastest way to finish them.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunting strand points at one rare animal — follow his clues to its territory, track it quietly, and take the shot cleanly. Take Bret's missions as they come rather than leaving them for post-game, since his strand is tied to story progress.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida in shops, hideouts and mission areas; each set needs every card in it. Track sets in the collection menu and sweep one region at a time so no card is left behind.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK camera at 100 different locations. Each distinct spot counts once, so keep moving — photograph landmarks, viewpoints and street corners across the whole state rather than repeating the same block. The WAiNK app marks which spots are new.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind — the game's challenge list spans driving, combat, exploration and activities, and every finished challenge counts. Pick the easy ones first (short races, simple stunts, quick photo spots) and the total climbs fast.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it without getting caught. Partner co-op stretches are limited to certain story missions and hangout moments, so do this while a partner is actually with you — grab a fast car, break line of sight, hide until the stars drain, and escape clean. Once the story moves past the partner stretches, the chance is gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the level must stay on through all three robberies. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast one after another, and keep moving between them. Like the other partner trophy, this only works while a partner is with you, so do it during a partner stretch of the story.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — each new vehicle driven for the first time counts. Steal, borrow and test-drive everything: traffic cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all add to the count. Cruise new neighbourhoods and vehicle types instead of sticking to one favourite car.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Wait for a crowded fight, trigger Combat Focus when enemies are grouped, and chain the slow-motion shots — one enemy per trigger pull, five in a row, before the focus ends. Gang shootouts and police standoffs give the best crowds.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave the airport at VCIA in a way that was never scheduled — an unscheduled departure. The official description does not pin down the exact trigger, so treat the VCIA sequence as a one-time moment: when the airport mission takes you through VCIA, look for a plane or runway exit rather than the front door. If the moment passes, the trophy may not come back.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not a set of steps: it points at the Rhino tanks. Get into a Rhino and use it in a fight — the trophy is tied to tank combat, so take a Rhino into a wanted-level shootout and let the cannon do the work. The exact trigger is not pinned down by the official description, so try tank combat first and check the named guide if it does not pop.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses calling it in, no camera spotting you. Plan the entry, smash the cases fast, and be out before anyone raises the alarm — a silent approach with a getaway car parked close is the reliable way.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the bigger robbery jobs: crack the vault, grab the cash, and get clear of the wanted level before the next. Five clean escapes is the count — plan the getaway before the break-in, not after.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes through the city — block one, crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat. One clean robbery and escape is all it takes.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel; drive, fly and sail into every corner of the state, including the small islands and the far north. The area count in the stats menu shows what is left — sweep the blank patches last.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations are marked on the map once discovered; hit one per gang — nine robberies in total, one for each gang's turf. Work through the gangs in any order.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a quiet story moment rather than a repeatable activity: when the story brings you to Ocean Beach, order the cocktail and take in the view. Treat it as a one-time moment and do it while the story is there.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style — through the glass, in a stolen showroom car, with the alarms going. The moment is tied to a showroom sequence in the story, so when a mission puts you inside a showroom, take the loud way out instead of the door.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through to the end — finish all frames. Bowling is a repeatable activity, so there is no rush: walk in, bowl the game, and the trophy pops at the final frame.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — a story beat with your partner that the public notices. The official description does not pin down the exact trigger, so treat partner story beats as one-time moments: play them when they come and watch for the pop. Check the named guide if it does not unlock during the partner missions.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PlayStation tracks a count up to 500. Choices appear all through the story and side content: dialogue picks, approach decisions, who to help and who to leave. There is no wrong pick for this trophy; keep choosing and the count climbs to 500 on its own.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then pass it on the retry. The trophy is about the comeback: a failed mission or challenge that you clear the second time around pops it. Do not reload an old save after a failure; retry and finish it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a weird encounter out in Leonida. Strange events are scattered across the state and show up while exploring; keep an eye out in remote places and odd corners, and the trophy pops when you stumble into one. The exact event is not pinned down by the official description, so explore widely.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — strike a pedestrian from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Line up a slow pass, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops on the hit. Quiet streets with a few pedestrians make it easy to line up.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; hand them to a contact to wash them into clean cash. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so keep laundering after every big score and the $250,000 adds up.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, car mods, food, anything bought in a shop counts. The total is cumulative, so it climbs on its own as you gear up; in cleanup, buy out a weapon's attachments or a full wardrobe to close the gap.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages go on sale as the story opens up new areas; check the property listings on the in-game web and buy each one when it appears. Eight owned garages is the count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on the in-game phone, add a vehicle you own or have just taken, and repeat for ten different vehicles. Any mix of cars and bikes counts — register as you go and the trophy pops at ten.
